jobs.title: Senior FP&A Manager (Contract)
jobs.description:
Cloudinary is the Image and Video API platform trusted by millions of developers and over 10,000 companies worldwide. Our powerful tools fuel websites to be faster, richer in user engagement, and breakthrough creativity. With a growing suite of products that support everything from developer efficiency to brand storytelling, Cloudinary is becoming the visual layer of the web.

Cloudinary has a globally distributed team across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, united by a shared commitment to building smart, scalable technology and a culture rooted in humility, curiosity, and collaboration. At Cloudinary, we celebrate Life & Work. We believe in healthy growth, working with purpose, and creating meaningful value. If you’re looking for a place where your voice matters and your work truly makes an impact, this may be the opportunity for you.


Cloudinary is seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior FP&A Manager to join the CFO Office. Reporting to the VP of Finance, FP&A, you will lead company-wide financial planning, forecasting, cash flow management, and performance analysis. As a key business partner to Finance and executive leadership, you will drive financial visibility, operational discipline, and data-driven decision-making while helping build the processes, rigor, and scalability required for Cloudinary’s journey toward becoming a public company.
 
This is a 6-month contract position, requiring a minimum of 2 days at our San Jose Office.

What You’ll Do
- Support the company’s Annual Operating Plan (AOP), long-range planning, and rolling forecast processes, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and resource allocation.

- Own company-wide cash flow Annual Budget, forecasting and liquidity planning, including monthly, quarterly, annual, and long-term projections.

- Develop and maintain integrated financial models covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, and key SaaS operating metrics.

- Drive scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and risk assessments to support executive decision-making and strategic initiatives.

- Consolidate departmental forecasts into company-wide financial outlooks and evaluate risks and opportunities against plan.

- Partner with FinOps, Revenue Operations, GTM, and Business Analysis teams to improve revenue-to-cash visibility, collections forecasting, and cash predictability.

- Monitor and analyze key working capital drivers, including DSO, collections performance, and balance sheet cash impacts.

- Lead monthly and quarterly Budget vs. Actual (BvA) and Forecast vs. Actual (FvA) analyses, providing clear insights into business performance and cash flow trends.

- Partner with functional leaders to support operating expense planning, investment evaluations, and resource allocation decisions.

- Own and report on key SaaS operating metrics, including NRR, Gross Retention, CAC, CAC Payback period, Gross Margin, Operating Margin, Rule of 40, and Free Cash Flow

- Prepare executive, Board, and investor-ready financial reporting materials, translating complex financial information into actionable insights.

- Drive continuous improvement of FP&A processes, forecasting methodologies, governance, and financial systems to support scalability and IPO readiness.

- Collaborate closely with Accounting, ARR Reporting & Analysis, Procurement, RevOps, and other business partners to ensure consistency across planning, reporting, and operational processes.

- Support strategic initiatives, ad hoc analyses, and special projects that influence company growth and long-term value creation.
What We’re Looking For
-
10+ years of progressive FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance experience.

-
Experience in a public, pre-IPO, or high-growth private SaaS company, preferably with $100M+ ARR.

-
Strong understanding of SaaS business models, operating metrics, revenue drivers, and working capital management.

-
Demonstrated experience leading annual planning, long-range planning, forecasting, and executive reporting processes.

-
Proven ability to build and maintain complex financial models that support strategic and operational decision-making.

-
Strong understanding of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, liquidity management, and free cash flow drivers .

-
Experience preparing executive and Board-level presentations and influencing senior leadership decisions through financial insights.

-
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

-
Fluent English (written and spoken).
Tools & Systems
-
Advanced Excel and Google Sheets modeling skills.

-
Experience with NetSuite and Salesforce.

-
Experience with financial planning and consolidation systems (Planful, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, or similar) - a plus.

-
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools, including Claude Code or similar technologies, for FP&A use cases - an advantage.
Why Join Us?
-
Play a critical role in shaping the financial strategy of a category-leading SaaS company.

-
Partner directly with senior leadership on high-impact business decisions.

-
Help build the processes, discipline, and financial infrastructure required for long-term scale and public-company readiness.

-
Join a collaborative, high-performing Finance organization focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and business partnership.
#LI-GC1


We have you in mind. As an employee, you will experience many benefits, including:

Awesome technology
Top-talent peers
100% sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans for employees & family
HSA company contribution
Matching 401k program
Robust vacation & wellness policy 
Annual development stipend 
Catered lunches or a food stipend 

Cloudinary is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer dedicated to pursuing a diverse workforce.

jobs.title: SVP, Customer Success & Professional Services
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a SVP, Customer Success & Professional Services to lead and own Cloudinary’s Enterprise Customer Journey, ensuring enterprise customers realize measurable business value throughout their lifecycle with Cloudinary.
Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, you will own the strategy, operating model, and execution of the enterprise customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, value realization, and expansion. Your mission is to help customers maximize the value of their investment while building a scalable organization that drives retention, growth, and long-term loyalty.
As a member of the Customer Success leadership team, you will lead a team of CSM’s, who are customer-obsessed and respected by their customers, partner closely with Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Executive Leadership to create seamless customer experiences, accelerate time-to-value, and establish Cloudinary as a strategic partner for our enterprise customers.
This role is ideal for a customer-obsessed executive who combines strategic thinking, operational excellence, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership to build world-class customer experiences at scale.

Responsibilities

-
Define and execute Cloudinary’s customer journey strategy, driving customer adoption, retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.

-
Lead and scale high-performing global Customer Success Management Professional Services and Customer Education organizations across multiple regions, developing leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer advocacy.

-
Design and optimize customer lifecycle programs, including onboarding, implementation, adoption, success planning, renewal readiness, and value realization.

-
Drive operational excellence through customer segmentation, health scoring, lifecycle automation, AI-enabled engagement, customer analytics, and standardized operating models.

-
Partner with Sales to maximize customer growth opportunities while ensuring seamless transitions across the customer lifecycle.

-
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Support to advocate for customer needs, influence product strategy, and improve the overall customer experience.

-
Establish executive relationships with strategic customers, acting as a trusted advisor during critical milestones and complex business engagements.

-
Own business performance across customer success metrics including Net Revenue Retention, product adoption, customer health, time-to-value, Professional Services utilization, and customer satisfaction.
You Bring

-
15+ years of leadership experience in Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management, or related customer-facing functions within enterprise SaaS.

-
Experience serving technical buyers who get technical value out of their products.

-
Proven success building and scaling global Customer Success organizations supporting complex enterprise customers.

-
Strong understanding of enterprise customer lifecycle management, adoption strategies, value realization frameworks, and recurring revenue business models.

-
Experience leading Professional Services organizations responsible for enterprise implementations, consulting engagements, and customer onboarding.

-
Demonstrated ability to improve Net Revenue Retention, customer adoption, expansion, and long-term customer outcomes through scalable operating models.

-
Experience leveraging AI, automation, customer intelligence platforms, and analytics to improve customer engagement and organizational efficiency.

-
Strong executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships with C-level customer stakeholders and influence internal executive teams.

-
Exceptional cross-functional leadership and collaboration skills across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Operations.

-
Experience leading geographically distributed organizations within high-growth global SaaS businesses.

-
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

- Hybrid 2 days from the San Jose office minimum per week.
Nice to Have

-
Experience working with developer platforms, APIs, cloud technologies, digital asset management, or enterprise infrastructure products.

-
Contributions to Customer Success thought leadership, customer experience communities, or industry best practices.

-
MBA or similar degree.
Salary range - 
                
$360,000 - $440,000 base
25% Annual Bonus and Option plan and benefits

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Cloudinary is the Image and Video API platform trusted by millions of developers and over 10,000 companies worldwide. Our powerful tools fuel websites to be faster, richer in user engagement, and breakthrough creativity. With a growing suite of products that support everything from developer efficiency to brand storytelling, Cloudinary is becoming the visual layer of the web.

Cloudinary has a globally distributed team across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, united by a shared commitment to building smart, scalable technology and a culture rooted in humility, curiosity, and collaboration. At Cloudinary, we celebrate Life & Work. We believe in healthy growth, working with purpose, and creating meaningful value. If you’re looking for a place where your voice matters and your work truly makes an impact, this may be the opportunity for you.


Cloudinary is looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager to help enterprise customers maximise the value of our Image, Video and Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform.
As the primary point of contact for a portfolio of customers, you will build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders, helping them successfully adopt Cloudinary's solutions and achieve their business objectives. Working closely with Sales, Support, Professional Services, Product and R&D teams, you will proactively drive product adoption, customer satisfaction, conduct renewals and lead expansion opportunities.
This is a customer-facing, individual contributor role suited to someone who enjoys solving technical and business challenges while building long-term customer relationships.

Responsibilities:
- MINIMUM TWO DAYS PER WEEK WITHIN THE SAN JOSE OFFICE

- Manage a portfolio of enterprise customers throughout their post-sales journey.

- Serve as the primary technical point of contact, building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders.

- Guide customers on best practices for implementing and using Cloudinary's Image, Video and Digital Asset Management solutions.

- Deliver regular customer engagements, including business reviews, adoption planning and technical guidance sessions.

- Monitor customer health, product usage and adoption metrics to identify opportunities and potential risks.

- Develop and execute customer success plans to increase product adoption and support successful renewals.

- Identify customer growth opportunities and partner with Account Managers to support expansion conversations.

- Escalate customer issues when appropriate and coordinate with internal teams to drive timely resolution.

- Capture customer feedback and share relevant insights with Product and Engineering teams.

- Maintain accurate customer account information, success plans and activity within CRM and Customer Success platforms.
About You:
- 7+ years' experience in Customer Success or Technical Customer Success within a SaaS environment.

- Experience in CSM processes and practices

- Experience managing big enterprise customer relationships and supporting successful renewals.

- Technical aptitude with experience working with SaaS platforms: APIs, web technologies or cloud-based applications.

- Experience working with technical stakeholders, including developers, architects or engineering teams.

- Experience conducting renewal negotiations from the technical side with the Sales Representative

- Strong customer communication and relationship management skills.

- Comfortable using customer data and health metrics to prioritize engagement and improve adoption.

- Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously.

- Self-motivated, collaborative and focused on delivering an excellent customer experience.

- Willingness to travel up to 20% as required.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Digital Asset Management (DAM), media platforms, image or video technologies.

- Familiarity with CDN, cloud or developer-focused technologies.

- Experience working with enterprise SaaS customers.
#LI-BP1


We have you in mind. As an employee, you will experience many benefits, including:

Awesome technology
Top-talent peers
100% sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans for employees & family
HSA company contribution
Matching 401k program
Robust vacation & wellness policy 
Annual development stipend 
Catered lunches or a food stipend 

Cloudinary is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer dedicated to pursuing a diverse workforce.
